claims.statement: Management expects PBDIT margins to remain in the 18% to 20% range.
claims.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets full year FY27 volume growth in the band of 8% to 10%.
claims.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the industrial segment to continue growing at a higher rate than the decorative segment going forward.
claims.quote: Overall, my belief is that industrial will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative as we look ahead.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Consolidated PBDIT margins stand at approximately 20.6%, which is about 240 bps higher year-over-year.
facts.quote: PBDIT margins stand at about 20.6%, almost 240 bps higher YoY.

facts.statement: Products launched within a three-year time frame are included in the definition of new products or innovation.
facts.quote: Something which is in a three-year time frame is what we look at defining our new products.

facts.statement: The weighted average price increase implemented was about 7%.
facts.quote: The weighted average price increase has been about 7%.
